name: Shed Lite
description: Our Shed Lite initiative focuses on constructing small, affordable sheds to provide safe spaces for addicts and suffering people, helping them find peace and recovery.
contentSubHeading: Discover our mission and the impact we're making

projectFeatures.description: Every Shed Lite structure is assembled by volunteers from your community, turning lumber and love into a real place of refuge for someone in need.
We believe shelter should never be a barrier to healing. Shed Lite structures are provided at no cost to individuals walking through the hardest seasons of their lives.
A small, well-built shed gives a person something that addiction and hardship strips away — a space that is theirs, safe, and quiet enough to begin again.
From material sourcing to the final nail, each project draws neighbors together around a shared purpose: that no one in our town should face suffering without a safe place to land.
